description: Dienst zur Straßenbeleuchtung des Amtes Peitz is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportal.amt-peitz.de. This is a WMS service of the construction office Peitz to display all light points and the corresponding measured cable paths. The data structure complies with the specifications according to XPlanGML. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "WMS Street Lighting Service of the Office of Peitz" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include infoMapAccessService. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2013-10-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
